summary: Recommends debugging a when condition by putting the whole expression as the var of a debug task, illustrating a common bug of comparing an integer return code to a string.
questions: How do I debug a when condition that isn't working?
Why is rc == "127" false when the return code is 127?
How can I see what a conditional evaluates to?

answer_card.title: Debugging conditionals
answer_card.answer_md:
Put the full expression in a `debug` task's `var:`:

```yaml
- ansible.builtin.debug:
    var: bar_status.rc == "127"   # false
- ansible.builtin.debug:
    var: bar_status.rc == 127     # true
```

A common cause of surprises is comparing an integer as a string (or vice versa).
